Position Overview

Data Analyst - Entry Level (Remote). We are looking for the right people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Key Responsibilities
• Perform data engineering, data modeling and model deployment under general supervision.
• Analyze large scale complex business data (time series data, structured/unstructured) from various data sources and draw insights.
• Leverage common open-source Machine Learning/Deep Learning packages for identifying data patterns and/or building predictive models.
• Conduct statistical analysis to determine trends and significant data relationships.
• Keep up to date with the latest Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence advancements.
• Work with data engineers to design and construct data pipelines for reproducible analysis.
• Leverage cloud computing technologies like Microsoft Azure and distributed computing technologies like Apache Spark.
• Present results of analyses, including design of graphs, charts, tables, and other data visualizations.

Required Qualifications
• Industry experience in predictive modeling, data science and analysis.
• Knowledge of Machine Learning frameworks and packages, including Keras, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn and cloud computing platforms like Azure.
• Experience handling terabyte size datasets, diving into data to discover hidden patterns and using data visualization tools.
• Experience writing code in Python, R, Scala, and distributed computing technologies like Spark.
• Demonstrated teamwork, strong communication skills, and collaboration in complex engineering projects.
• Completion of an undergraduate degree in STEM.

Preferred Qualifications
• Master's degree in STEM is preferred.
• Candidates with qualifications exceeding the minimum requirements will be considered for higher level roles.

The Business Intelligence Analyst (Entry Level) supports the Business Intelligence & Data team by understanding and writing data queries, building visualizations, and working with end users to obtain clear and concise report requirements. The candidate should have familiarity with data models/relationships and strong analytical skills with great attention to detail. Eagerness to learn the business is a must.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in developing, maintaining, and enhancing dashboards and reports using BI tools

Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into BI tools and databases

Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across multiple data sources

Translate business requirements into technical reporting specifications

Document data sources, transformations, metrics definitions, and report logic

Collaborate with BI & Data team and business stakeholders to produce impactful reports

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Foundational knowledge of SQL (joins, aggregations)

Experience working with structured datasets (tables, schemas, relationships)

Familiarity with basic data warehousing and BI concepts

Detail-oriented

Ability to multi-task

Strong communication skills with both technical and nontechnical users

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field

Hands-on experience with BI tools (experience with Qlik products is a plus)

Familiarity with SQL Server

Data Modeling Fundamentals

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

Pratt & Whitney is working to once again transform the future of flight—designing, building, and servicing engines unlike any the world has ever seen. And because transformation begins from within, we’re seeking the people to drive it. So, calling all curious.

Come ready to explore and you’ll find a place where your talent takes flight—beyond the borders of title, a country, or your comfort zone. Bring your passion and commitment and we’ll welcome you into a tight-knit team that takes our mission personally. Channel your drive to make a difference into shaping an organization and an industry that’s evolving fast to the future.

At Pratt & Whitney, the difference you make is on display every day. Just look up. Are you ready to go beyond?

The AI/ML Methods group at Pratt & Whitney focuses on developing cutting-edge artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions to solve complex challenges in aerospace engineering. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of experts and contribute to impactful projects shaping the future of aviation.

What You Will Do
• Collaborate with team members to design, develop, and implement AI/ML models for applications such as predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, optimization problems, or natural language processing.
• Analyze large datasets from various sources to extract insights and validate model performance.
• Develop scripts or tools to automate data preprocessing, feature engineering, or model evaluation workflows.
• Document methodologies and results clearly for internal presentations or reports.

What You Will Learn
• Engineering Interns at Pratt & Whitney work on challenging, meaningful, and impactful projects across our business.
• Our intern program seeks to help you develop an understanding of the aerospace industry and learn about our company and its operations.
• This internship provides hands-on experience in applying AI/ML techniques within the aerospace industry while fostering professional growth through mentorship opportunities and exposure to real-world challenges.

Qualifications You Must Have
• Enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Aerospace/Electrical), Mathematics, or a related field.
• Minimum Cumulative GPA of 3.0

Qualifications We Prefer
• Experience in Python or other relevant languages
• Experience with machine learning algorithms (e.g., supervised/unsupervised learning) and statistical methods
• Experience applying AI/ML in aerospace context
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) for ML workflows
• Experience working with data manipulation tools such as Pandas or NumPy
• Experience with libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn

Learn More & Apply Now!

Position Overview

Position: Business Data Analyst, Construction. We are one of the leading mechanical contractors in the eastern United States. Our construction and service (mechanical and electrical) experience spans commercial and government projects including data centers, hospitals, sports stadiums, convention centers, hotels, and research laboratories. The Business Data Analyst assists the company in meeting its objectives by supporting management and providing analysis of business data for effective decision making and organizational efficiency improvement. Location: Baltimore, MD 21227. Reports to: Vice President. FLSA Status: Full-Time / Exempt. Work Shift: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. / Mon. – Fri.

Key Responsibilities
• Aggregates and performs statistical analysis on business data based on requests from project teams or senior leadership.
• Integrates data from multiple sources or functional areas, ensuring data accuracy and integrity, and updates data as needed.
• Writes queries or reports to provide data for various analytical projects and interprets data to identify business trends and conduct root cause analysis.
• Generates analytical and statistical information in various formats using advanced features of Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Power BI, and related software.
• Complies with all company operating policies, procedures, and safety programs as established.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, and/or a related field.
• One to three years of professional experience, including internship experience.
• Advanced experience in Microsoft Office Excel and Power BI applications.
• Familiarity with software applications utilized in data analytics for business.
• Must possess professional integrity and be trustworthy.
• Strong interpersonal communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Proven ability to organize and manage multiple projects.
• Ability to independently analyze and solve problems on both strategic and tactical levels.
• Commitment to company values.
• Effective communication, cooperation, and collaboration with employees, government agencies, contractors, vendors, and/or suppliers.

Job Overview

We’re looking for an entry-level Financial Data Analyst who’s passionate about transforming financial numbers into clear insights that support budgeting, forecasting, and operational decision-making. You’ll work closely with senior analysts, finance teams, and operations leaders to maintain financial datasets, build reports, and identify trends that help the business manage costs and improve performance.

Responsibilities
• Collect, clean, and standardize financial datasets from internal systems, spreadsheets, and reporting tools.
• Assist with month-end and quarter-end financial analysis, including revenue trends, expense patterns, and variance explanations.
• Build reports and dashboards to support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.
• Analyze cost drivers, spending behavior, and operational metrics to identify inefficiencies.
• Support the finance team in developing financial models and scenario analysis tools.
• Track KPIs, create data visualizations, and summarize findings for leadership.
• Maintain accuracy, quality, and documentation of all financial data sources.

Requirements
• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, formulas).
• Basic SQL experience for querying financial datasets.
• Understanding of income statements, balance sheets, and basic financial concepts.
• Analytical mindset with strong attention to numerical accuracy.
• Ability to explain findings in a simple, business-friendly way.
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Compensation
• Competitive entry-level salary.
• Performance-based bonuses.

Potential Benefits Depending On Company Policy.

Clear growth path into Financial Analyst, Senior Analyst, or FP&A roles.

Credit Score Requirement

Due to the financial nature of this role and access to sensitive transaction data, all shortlisted applicants must undergo a standard credit check and background verification before interview scheduling.

About the role

We are hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to help design, build, and deploy ML solutions. This role focuses on turning models into reliable systems and collaborating with engineering teams to operationalize ML.

What you will do
• Develop and train ML models with reproducible pipelines
• Build data preprocessing workflows and feature generation
• Deploy models to production and monitor performance
• Work with stakeholders to define success metrics and test outcomes
• Document experiments and contribute to best practices

What you are looking for
• Degree in CS, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
• Strong Python, data handling (pandas), and ML fundamentals
• Familiarity with scikit-learn and basic model evaluation
• Understanding of software engineering basics (Git, testing, modular code)

Nice to have
• PyTorch or TensorFlow
• Experience with ML pipelines, Airflow, or workflow orchestration
• Exposure to CI/CD, Docker, and cloud services
